VIKASH JOTHIRAMALIANGAM

Senior Business Analyst | Business Architecture | Banking & Payments Transformation

Chennai, India | +91 9789015613 |  vikashbackup407@gmail.com

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst with 12+ years of experience across Banking, Wealth & Investment Management, Core Banking, Payments and Securities Services, delivering business transformation and technology-enabled change initiatives across global banking environments. Strong expertise in Business Architecture, Target Operating Model (TOM) design, AS-IS/TO-BE process modelling, Customer Journey Mapping, Business Capability Mapping and Process Architecture. Experienced in analysing current-state operating models, identifying process and capability gaps, and defining future-state processes, operating models and business requirements. Proven ability to translate complex business needs into functional requirements, process designs and solution specifications.

CORE COMPETENCIES

Business Architecture & Transformation

Target Operating Model (TOM) Design | Business Capability Mapping | Process Architecture

AS-IS / TO-BE Process Modelling | Customer Journey Mapping | Capability Gap Assessment

Operating Model Design | Business Process Re-engineering | Process Improvement & Transformation

Banking & Payments

Banking Transformation | Payment Processing & Payment Lifecycle | Cross-Border Payments

Payment Transactions | Core Banking | Wealth Management | Securities Services | Trade Lifecycle | Custody & Clearing

Business Analysis & Delivery

Requirements Elicitation | BRD / FSD / Functional Specifications | User Stories & Acceptance Criteria

Gap & Impact Analysis | Business Rules | Process & Workflow Analysis | Requirement Traceability | UAT / SIT

Stakeholder Management | JAD / Requirement Workshops | Agile / Scrum | Waterfall

Tools: JIRA | Confluence | Azure DevOps | MS Visio | Balsamiq | Draw.io | SQL | Power BI | Tableau | Excel

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

TEMENOS INDIA PVT. LTD.

Senior Business Analyst / Lead Business Analyst | Dec 2025 – Present | Chennai

Client/Engagement: Mirabaud Asset Management – Wealth Management & Core Banking Transformation

Worked as a Business Analyst across Temenos Wealth Suite Front Office, Portfolio Management and Temenos Transact Core Banking modules supporting banking transformation initiatives.

Partnered with business stakeholders, relationship managers, portfolio managers and technology teams to elicit, analyse and document business requirements across Wealth Management and Core Banking.

Analysed existing business processes and performed AS-IS / TO-BE gap analysis to identify functional gaps, process dependencies and transformation opportunities.

Contributed to Target Operating Model (TOM) definition by analysing current-state banking and payment processes and designing optimized future-state workflows.

Developed end-to-end process flows and solution design documentation aligning Temenos Wealth Suite capabilities with Temenos Transact Core Banking.

Created Customer Journey Maps covering customer onboarding, account servicing, transaction processing and payment-related journeys, identifying pain points and improvement opportunities.

Developed Business Capability Maps linking business capabilities with processes, applications and functional requirements across Wealth Management, Core Banking and Payments.

Authored Functional Specification Documents covering client onboarding, account lifecycle, portfolio management, transaction processing and payment workflows.

Defined business rules, data mapping logic and workflow enhancements for Wealth Management and Banking services integration.

Prepared HLEs by analysing requirements, solution impact, dependencies and implementation effort.

Worked with Development, QA and Product teams throughout solution design, implementation and validation.

Prepared SIT/UAT scenarios covering portfolio operations, trade lifecycle, customer accounts, payments and core banking transactions.

Managed requirement traceability and BA artefacts including BRDs, FSDs, HLEs, process flows and testing documentation.

Key Business Architecture Contributions: TOM | AS-IS/TO-BE | Process Architecture | Customer Journey Mapping | Business Capability Mapping | Gap Analysis

WELLS FARGO INDIA GBS - Business Aligned Finance Associate – Wealth & Investment Management | Nov 2021 – Oct 2025 | Chennai

Worked with the Wealth & Investment Management – Banking, Lending & Trust function supporting business analysis and transformation initiatives.

Conducted JAD sessions, stakeholder interviews and requirement workshops to elicit and document business requirements.

Performed detailed AS-IS process analysis and TO-BE process design across Wealth & Investment Management banking workflows.

Identified process gaps, dependencies and opportunities for business transformation across Wealth Management, Banking, Trade Lifecycle and Payments.

Developed Customer Journey Maps across onboarding, account management, investment portfolio management, transaction processing and payment-related activities.

Performed Business Capability Mapping across Wealth Management, Banking, Investment Portfolio Management, Trade Lifecycle and Payments, mapping capabilities to processes, applications and stakeholders.

Contributed to Target Operating Model definition by analysing existing operating processes, identifying capability/process gaps and supporting future-state operating models.

Worked with Product Owners and SMEs to create user stories, epics and acceptance criteria.

Supported solution architects in developing technology solutions across Fixed Income, Equities, Commodities and Global Capital Markets.

Analysed dependencies and cross-functional impacts across Wealth Management, Banking, Trade Lifecycle and Payments.

Created UML diagrams, process flows, wireframes and functional documentation using MS Visio and Balsamiq.

Supported Agile delivery through JIRA, backlog management, sprint planning, reviews and retrospectives.

Coordinated UAT and validated application functionality against business requirements.

Business Architecture Highlights: AS-IS/TO-BE | TOM | Customer Journey Mapping | Business Capability Mapping | Process Architecture | Gap Analysis

BNP PARIBAS SECURITIES SERVICES - Business Support Assistant Manager – Data as a Service | 2020 – 2021 | Chennai

Partnered with cross-functional teams during new fund launches, gathering requirements and validating business/data setup across internal systems and custody platforms.

Led client onboarding and offboarding initiatives, coordinating requirements, technology teams and operational stakeholders.

Managed institutional client stakeholder communication and supported trade lifecycle data across Equities and Bonds.

Performed data analysis, reconciliation and data-quality assessments to identify process and system issues.

Developed UAT plans, test cases and completion reports to ensure requirements traceability.

Performed AS-IS / TO-BE analysis across client onboarding, asset transition, custody, clearing and payment-related banking processes.

Developed Customer Journey Maps for institutional client onboarding, account setup, asset transition and servicing.

Conducted Business Capability Mapping across client onboarding, custody, securities settlement, payments, clearing and client reporting.

Contributed to TOM initiatives by analysing operating models and aligning future-state processes, roles, controls and technology dependencies.

Worked on payment and cash-related processes including cash balance transfers, FX setup, custody/clearing, reconciliation and transaction lifecycle processes.

BNP PARIBAS - Business / Client Support Analyst – NeoLink | 2015 – 2020 | Chennai

Provided L1/L2 application support for NeoLink across the Asia-Pacific region, acting as liaison between institutional clients, business and technology teams.

Analysed user requirements and existing business processes to identify system enhancement and client experience opportunities.

Gathered and documented BRDs for new and customised client reporting requirements.

Engaged stakeholders to define, validate and prioritise business requirements.

Coordinated integration testing and UAT for system enhancements.

Supported client onboarding, implementation and post-implementation activities.

Developed process flow diagrams, functional specifications and test documentation.

Supported process improvement initiatives focused on client onboarding, reporting and issue-resolution efficiency.

DOMAIN & TRANSFORMATION EXPOSURE

Wealth Management | Investment Management | Banking | Payments | Securities Services | Custody & Clearing

Trade Lifecycle | Fixed Income | Equities | Commodities | Global Capital Markets

Client Onboarding | Asset Transitions | Corporate Actions | FX Setup | Static Data Management

Process Optimisation | KPI Definition | Risk & Control Matrix | SOP Development | Data Migration

EDUCATION

MBA – Finance & Marketing | Sai Ram Institute of Technology, Anna University | 2012–2014

B.Com – General | A.M. Jain College, Madras University | 2009–2012

CAREER PATH

BNP Paribas India – Business Data Service / Assistant Manager | Jan 2014 – Oct 2021

Wells Fargo India – Business Aligned Finance Associate | Nov 2021 – Oct 2025

Temenos India – Senior Business Analyst / Lead Business Analyst | Dec 2025 – Present

Vikash Jothiramaliangam | Senior Business Analyst | Banking & Payments Transformation
